title: Gate host-only lobby configuration and start requests
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Implement only the owned source and tests, using the exact pinned API section in PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS. No imports from unmerged A/B modules, no manifests/barrels/App.tsx/shared task metadata edits and no new dependencies. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. Use existing deterministic engine RNG only where the contract permits. Never turn a trusted verifier input into a claim of cryptographic verification. Unspecified rules remain explicit named decision-required results; no worker invents policies. Preserve existing T01–T10 API/tests. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests, then node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full. Return a handoff with paths, API, actual checks, benchmark receipt references and limitations. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, deployment, credential access, task-issue mutation or budget changes. Implement hostLobbyPermission exactly as frozen in section B085 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Only the verified host in lobby may configure/kick/start. Kick requires another existing player. Start requires at least five final seats, every human ready and either all configured seats occupied or trusted fillBots enabled; configuration uses seats5–10. This is an admission ceiling, not role assignment or trusted bot creation.
acceptance: Only host-lobby actions succeed; nonhost and live-match requests receive fixed denied reasons.
Start covers full ready tables and approved bot-filling with ready humans; unready humans or missing nonbot seats deny.
Self/absent kick targets, duplicate IDs/readies, absent host and impossible capacities reject or deny deterministically without mutation.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.

Scoped lint, typecheck and meaningful tests pass, followed by node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; handoff records actual outcomes and receipt references without claiming App/provider integration.
